dataset_version: PureDocBench released 1,475-page full tracks: clean, digital degradation and real degradation (4,425 matched images).
measurement_operator: PureDocBench maintainer publication; original execution operator not separately identified
configuration: Exact released model label GLM-5.3-Flash; original checkpoint, inference configuration, ground-truth hash and evaluator revision are not pinned per run.
visible_context: 1,475 pages × 3 matched tracks. Avg₃ averages track overalls; reading order is separate. Original run revisions unavailable.
note: Verified original headline values against the pinned leaderboard.csv and added raw track component values from components.csv. Text and reading-order edit distances are lower-is-better; formula CDM and table TEDS are higher-is-better. Retain released Overall/Avg3 values: current source warns that historical component rounding can prevent exact reconstruction. The publication is a released summary, not a new rerun.
provisional_reasons: PureDocBench publishes released summaries; the original execution operator, per-model ground-truth hash and evaluator/inference revisions are not established.

operator: TeleOCR authors; original baseline execution not established by comparison card
note: Separate TeleOCR comparison observation. Clean, digital-degraded and real-degraded components are distinct; text edit distance is lower better, formula CDM and table TEDS higher better. avg3 is the site-computed arithmetic mean of three reported condition scores, rounded to two decimals under the existing PureDoc method; not an extra author-reported measurement.
